title: Notice of Proposed Real Property Tax Increase (2025)

blocks.text: Information required by § 58.1-3321 of the Code of Virginia follows:
NOTICE OF PROPOSED REAL PROPERTY TAX INCREASE
The Keysville Town Council will hold a public hearing on Monday, July 14th, at 7:00 PM at the Town Office, 120 J St., Keysville, VA 23947 to receive public input on the following:
The Town of Keysville proposes to increase property tax levies.
Assessment Increase: Total assessed value of real property exceeds last year’s total assessed value of real property by 101.5 percent (101.5%).

Lowered Rate Necessary to Offset Increased Assessment: The tax rate which would levy the same amount of real estate tax as last year, when multiplied by the new total assessed value of real estate, would be $0.0794 (7.94 cents) per $100 of assessed value. This rate will be known as the “lowered tax rate.”

Effective Rate Increase: The Town of Keysville proposes to adopt a tax rate of $0.12 (12 cents) per $100 of assessed value, which is $0.04 (4 cents) less than the tax rate currently in effect $0.16 (16 cents). The difference between the lowered tax rate and the proposed rate would be $0.0406 (4.06 cents) per $100, or 33.83 percent (33.83%). This difference will be known as the “effective tax rate increase.”
Individual property taxes may, however, increase at a percentage greater than or less than the above percentage.
Proposed Total Budget Increase: Based on the proposed real property tax rate and changes in other revenues, the total budget of the Town of Keysville will exceed last year’s by 4.23 percent (4.23%).
